attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changing the CSP/Permissions-Policy separator from comma to semicolon is actually the correct spec-compliant fix, but it changes the literal header output format that any downstream tenant/app config, tests, or browser-facing behavior relying on the previous (technically invalid) comma-separated value could depend on, so it warrants a senior review despite being low code-complexity."}

reason: Changing the CSP/Permissions-Policy separator from comma to semicolon is actually the correct spec-compliant fix, but it changes the literal header output format that any downstream tenant/app config, tests, or browser-facing behavior relying on the previous (technically invalid) comma-separated value could depend on, so it warrants a senior review despite being low code-complexity.
